6a5982b16d.why: The required rcx value is the incoming rsp minus 0xb8, so one LEA replaces the stack subtraction and copy while leaving rsp untouched.

93702bddbe.why: The two differently arranged products, live partial-register result in xmm2, rounding, packing, and pointer and counter updates leave no removable instruction.

5189c5063a.why: The live xmm1 value includes its untouched upper half, and the full xmm0 output requires the existing shuffle, products, saturated addition, and packing.

22baa72fe5.why: The three vector copies establish distinct live outputs, and the second four-byte store still requires an extraction shift because SSE4.1 is unavailable.
